worldcombat.skill.gravapple.summary: Send a big apple high above the target and let go: gravity carries it down faster and faster while it corrects its own aim. A struck target loses Defence; an airborne target is driven back into the ground and takes far heavier damage. A missed apple stays where it lands for anyone to pick up. Heavy drop is higher, denser and heavier; light drop is quicker and reaches further.
A living hit takes %1$s non-contact damage with a %2$s block apple radius; an airborne target takes x1.5.
The apple is released %1$s blocks above the target, falling at %2$s blocks per tick and steering %3$s degrees per tick toward it.
You can drop within %1$s blocks; a hit lowers Defence by %2$s stage for %3$s, and an airborne target also takes a %4$s blocks per tick downward impulse.
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.heavy.on: Heavy drop: a higher, denser, heavier apple, at the cost of longer preparation and cooldown and a shorter reach.
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.heavy.off: Light drop: quicker to cast and further reaching, but a lighter blow.
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.growth.0: From level %1$s the drop rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.growth.1: From level %1$s the drop rises to %2$s and the crush mark lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.use.0: Drag a flier out of the air
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.use.1: Lower a single target's Defence and punish a planted foe
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.use.2: Fall vertically past cover or high ground, no line of sight needed
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.preference.h: On: the apple is hauled higher and hits harder, at the cost of longer preparation and cooldown and a shorter reach. Off: quicker, further reaching, a little lighter.
worldcombat.skill.gravapple.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of dropping. Larger values open from further away.
On: prefer an airborne target (driven back into the ground for heavier damage), and rank already-guardbroken targets last. Off: treat it as an ordinary ranged attack.
